facts.business: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited manufactures compression systems and refrigeration solutions, offering integrated solutions across the value chain from design and manufacturing to installation and lifecycle support for sectors such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power, steel, food processing and pharmaceuticals.

capacity_or_capex.item: New foundry at Nashik with lost foam casting technology
Specialty motor plant for in-house development of Tyche semi-hermetic compressors
Hydrocarbon-free forging and stabilisation of lost foam casting for critical compressor parts

guidance_or_targets.statement: PLI Scheme application filed to enter Commercial Air conditioning space (Market size > ₹ 5,000 Crores) with unique 'Zephyros' offering

key_risks: Input cost volatility, particularly in metals and energy
Execution risks associated with large and complex projects
Regulatory and compliance risks driven by evolving policies and standards
Technology risks linked to changing customer requirements and industry advancements
Competitive intensity increasing and uneven capital expenditure cycles across sectors
Subdued investment activity in oil and gas sector in India and Middle East
facts.related_party_note: No Loans, Guarantees covered under the provisions of Section 186 of the Act are given/provided/made during the reporting year. Investments made in Mutual Funds and Fixed Deposits.
